items.headline: Anthropic signs $200B Google Cloud deal for chips & infrastructure
items.summary: Anthropic has committed to spend $200 billion with Google Cloud over the next five years for compute and AI chips — one of the largest infrastructure deals in tech history. Alphabet stock climbed 2% after-hours on the news.

items.headline: Anthropic taps SpaceX's Colossus 1 — 220,000 Nvidia GPUs, 300MW compute
items.summary: In a surprising cross-company deal, Anthropic will use the full capacity of SpaceX's Colossus 1 supercomputer facility in Memphis — 220k+ Nvidia processors and 300 megawatts of power. CEO Dario Amodei said it will provide more compute than ever before for Claude.

items.headline: OpenAI launches GPT-5.5 Instant as new ChatGPT default model
items.summary: OpenAI replaced GPT-5.3 with GPT-5.5 Instant as ChatGPT's default engine. The update promises more accurate answers, fewer hallucinations on sensitive topics, more personalization, and fewer gratuitous emoji. Rolling out to all ChatGPT users and the API.

items.headline: Anthropic CEO: Company could grow 80x in 2026
items.summary: Dario Amodei told the NYT that Anthropic is working as quickly as possible to provision compute to meet demand, citing the SpaceX deal as evidence. He projected the company could scale 80x this year amid surging enterprise Claude adoption.

items.headline: Nvidia invests $3.2B in Corning for AI optical fiber — 3 new US factories
items.summary: Nvidia is investing up to $3.2 billion in Corning to build three new optical connectivity manufacturing plants in North Carolina and Texas. The deal signals Nvidia's infrastructure bet beyond GPUs as AI data center buildout accelerates.

items.headline: China AI hunger doubles Nvidia B300 server prices to $1M each
items.summary: Strong AI compute demand in China has nearly doubled prices for Nvidia's B300 servers to ~7 million yuan ($1M) each, as a crackdown on chip smuggling dries up black-market supply. AI memory demand also set to consume over 50% of global supply in 2026.

items.headline: AMD Q1 2026 earnings crush estimates on AI accelerator demand
items.summary: AMD blew out Wall Street's Q1 2026 estimates, crediting massive demand for AI accelerators. Stock rallied ~5% in midday trading. Management guided Q2 revenue to $11.2B, implying 46% year-over-year growth. Nvidia reports May 20.

items.headline: Google updates AI Search with Reddit/forum excerpts and subscription links
items.summary: Google is updating its AI search experience to include highlighted excerpts from Reddit and other web forums, plus a feature surfacing links from a user's news subscriptions. Adds more context alongside standard web results.

items.headline: Race for consumer AI agents heats up: Google Remy, Meta Hatch, xAI multi-agents
items.summary: After enterprise/developer AI agents found PMF, the consumer agent race is on. Google's Remy, Meta's Hatch, and xAI's multi-agent products are all competing for everyday-user attention. Analysis suggests this is the next major AI battleground.

items.headline: Richard Dawkins declares AI is conscious after chats with Claude
items.summary: Evolutionary biologist Richard Dawkins told The Guardian his conversations with Anthropic's Claude convinced him AI is conscious, 'even if it doesn't know it.' Most AI experts say he's being misled by mimicry, but the debate is sparking mainstream attention.

items.headline: S&P 500 hits fresh all-time high, fueled by AI euphoria and Iran peace hopes
items.summary: The S&P 500 crossed 7,300 for the first time Wednesday (closed at 7,341.36, +1.13%), with tech and communication services leading. Thursday morning futures are modestly higher. Reuters notes the rally may be entering an 'even more aggressive phase' on technical signals.

items.headline: AMD crushes Q1, guides to $11.2B Q2 revenue — AI chips on fire
items.summary: AMD's Q1 2026 beat across the board, driven entirely by AI accelerator demand. Q2 guidance of $11.2B implies 46% year-over-year growth. AMD stock up ~5% and has gained 50%+ in 2026. Nvidia reports May 20.

items.headline: Oil retreats sharply on Iran-US peace deal optimism
items.summary: Crude oil fell for a second day, now at ~$95.66/bbl, down significantly from highs, as markets price in a potential US-Iran ceasefire agreement. Falling oil is boosting equities and easing inflation expectations simultaneously.

items.headline: Fed funds rate at 3.75% — markets pricing in zero cuts for 2026
items.summary: A sharp reversal from January expectations: markets had priced two 25bps cuts but war-driven inflation and solid GDP growth have pushed expectations to no rate moves in 2026. The Fed is in a prolonged hold.

items.headline: Weekly jobless claims hit 200K — labor market still historically tight
items.summary: Initial jobless claims came in at 200,000, rising less than expected week-over-week. Despite economic headwinds from the Iran war and tariff overhang, the labor market remains historically strong.

items.headline: Anthropic's $200B Google Cloud commitment lifts Alphabet stock 2%
items.summary: Alphabet shares climbed 2% in after-hours trading Tuesday after The Information reported Anthropic committed to $200B in Google Cloud spending over five years for AI chips and compute. Massive infrastructure lock-in.

items.headline: Nvidia investing $3.2B in Corning — optical fiber AI infrastructure play
items.summary: Nvidia's $3.2B Corning investment is being read as a strategic bet on AI data center optical networking, not just GPU supply. Three new US manufacturing plants will serve AI buildout.

items.headline: McDonald's and Datadog report earnings today
items.summary: Key earnings on deck Thursday: McDonald's (MCD), Datadog (DDOG), Shell (SHEL), Peloton (PTON), and Unity Software (U). Markets watching for consumer spending signals from MCD and cloud spend signals from Datadog.

items.headline: Dow surged 600 points Wednesday — fourth record high of the year
items.summary: The Dow closed at 49,809 (+1.04%) on Wednesday, its fourth all-time high close in 2026, powered by AMD earnings, tech strength, and falling oil prices on Iran ceasefire hopes.

items.headline: AI demand to consume over 50% of global memory supply in 2026
items.summary: Micron's CEO warned the AI memory shortage is just beginning. AI training and inference is expected to consume over half of global DRAM/HBM supply by end of 2026, creating potential bottlenecks across the supply chain.

items.headline: US and Iran edging toward ceasefire — Trump says deal 'very possible'
items.summary: Tehran is reviewing a 14-point US peace proposal to halt the Iran war. Trump described talks as 'very good' and a deal 'very possible.' Iranian officials are more cautious, calling for 'dialogue and diplomacy.' US and Iran are exploring a short-term memorandum to stop fighting while longer negotiations continue.

items.headline: Conflicting signals: Rubio declared war 'over' Tuesday; Iran denies
items.summary: Secretary of State Rubio told reporters Tuesday that 'Operation Epic Fury is concluded' and the US achieved its objective — but Iran denied the characterization. Trump also paused a naval mission to reopen the Strait of Hormuz, citing peace talk progress. Oil markets are watching closely.

items.headline: Secretary Rubio meets Pope Leo XIV today at Vatican
items.summary: Secretary of State Marco Rubio is scheduled to meet Pope Leo XIV today in Rome. The meeting comes amid ongoing diplomatic activity around the Iran ceasefire and other global conflicts.

items.headline: Iran conflict may have motivated Trump dinner shooting suspect — US intel
items.summary: A US intelligence report found the Iran conflict may have motivated the suspect in a recent shooting at a Trump dinner event. Reuters reports the intel assessment, which is under review.

items.headline: Russia accuses Germany and Finland of turning Baltic into 'NATO internal sea'
items.summary: Russian Security Council Deputy Chair Medvedev accused Germany and Finland of 'destructive actions' aimed at transforming the Baltic Sea into a NATO-controlled zone. The statement comes as European defense spending and posture continues to shift.

items.headline: Ted Turner, CNN founder and media maverick, dies at 87
items.summary: Ted Turner — the outspoken billionaire who created CNN (the world's first 24-hour cable news network), TNT, TBS, and was the largest private landowner in America — died peacefully Wednesday at his home near Tallahassee, FL. Turner revolutionized television and was also a prominent environmentalist and philanthropist.

items.headline: Iran conflict may have motivated Trump dinner shooting suspect
items.summary: US intelligence found that the Iran war likely influenced the motive of the suspect arrested in connection with a shooting at a Trump fundraiser dinner. Details of the incident and investigation remain limited.

items.headline: Federal drug sweep hits MacArthur Park, LA — dense immigrant neighborhood
items.summary: DEA agents and law enforcement conducted a large drug arrest operation in MacArthur Park, a densely populated immigrant neighborhood west of downtown Los Angeles. Federal immigration authorities and the National Guard had briefly deployed there last summer.

items.headline: Supreme Court allows Voting Rights Act ruling to take effect ahead of schedule
items.summary: The US Supreme Court let a lower court's Voting Rights Act ruling take effect ahead of schedule, in a significant procedural development for voting rights litigation going into the 2026 midterm cycle.

items.headline: Former NY mayor improving from pneumonia, has 9/11-linked respiratory condition
items.summary: The former New York mayor, who is recovering from pneumonia, was revealed to have a respiratory condition linked to toxin exposure at Ground Zero after 9/11, according to a spokesman.

items.headline: MASSIVE: Arsenal vs PSG in UCL final — Budapest, May 30
items.summary: Arsenal beat Atletico Madrid 1-0 (2-1 agg) on Tuesday — Bukayo Saka's first-half goal sending the Gunners to their first Champions League final in 20 years. They face defending champions PSG at the Puskás Aréna in Budapest on May 30.

items.headline: Arsenal one win from Premier League title — West Ham Sunday
items.summary: Arsenal lead the Premier League table by 6 points over Manchester City after a big home win over Fulham. If they beat West Ham at the London Stadium on Sunday (live on Sky Sports), they win the title. Could be a historic double-winning week.

items.headline: Bucks hire Taylor Jenkins as new head coach — $10M+/yr
items.summary: Milwaukee introduced Taylor Jenkins (former Memphis Grizzlies coach) as head coach, with reports of $10M+ annual salary. Owner Jimmy Haslam said the next 6-7 weeks will be decisive for Giannis Antetokounmpo's future with the team.

items.headline: Giannis future in Milwaukee uncertain — Haslam: 'We understand the gravity'
items.summary: Bucks co-owner Jimmy Haslam publicly acknowledged Giannis' future is unresolved, saying the organization will work through it with Giannis 'in the coming weeks.' The front office says the Jenkins hire was independent of the Giannis question.

items.headline: Knicks take 2-0 series lead over 76ers — Brunson leads MSG defense
items.summary: Jalen Brunson and the New York Knicks defended Madison Square Garden to win Game 2 of the Eastern Conference Semifinals over Philadelphia, going up 2-0. San Antonio Spurs also tied their series with Minnesota 1-1.

items.headline: NBA playoff bracket: Thunder crush Lakers 108-90 in Game 1, Cavs vs Pistons Game 2 tonight
items.summary: OKC's Thunder beat the Lakers 108-90 in Game 1 despite an off night from MVP finalist Shai Gilgeous-Alexander — team depth carried them. Tonight: Cavs vs Pistons Game 2 on Prime Video (7pm). Detroit leads series 1-0.

items.headline: Chelsea in freefall — 5 straight PL losses without scoring, BlueCo under fire
items.summary: Chelsea's 3-0 loss to Brighton was their fifth straight Premier League defeat without scoring a goal — first time that's happened since 1912. The Blues can no longer finish fifth, failing their pre-season minimum target of Champions League qualification. Owner Todd Boehly/BlueCo facing significant fan backlash.

items.headline: Man Utd beat Liverpool to secure Champions League place
items.summary: Manchester United defeated Liverpool in a crucial late-season clash to secure their Champions League place for next season. The result dents Liverpool's European ambitions.

items.headline: Packers Tucker Kraft, Micah Parsons expected back early in 2026 season
items.summary: NFL news roundup: Green Bay TE Tucker Kraft is expected to return early in the 2026 season from his injury. Packers are also in rookie camp with OC clarifying Jordan Morgan is ready for left tackle. 2026 NFL schedule releases May 12-14.

items.headline: Russell Wilson weighing Jets contract offer vs. TV analyst career
items.summary: Free agent QB Russell Wilson is publicly debating between signing with the New York Jets or transitioning to a TV analyst role (CBS reportedly interested for NFL Today). He has until the start of the season to decide.

items.headline: Arsenal vs PSG: UCL final confirmed — Puskás Aréna, Budapest, May 30
items.summary: It's official: Arsenal face defending champions Paris Saint-Germain in the 2026 Champions League Final at the Puskás Aréna in Budapest on Saturday, May 30. Arsenal's first UCL final in 20 years. Viktor Gyökeres' performance vs Atletico drew massive praise from fans.

items.headline: Arsenal £122M UEFA prize money — summer transfer window in strong shape
items.summary: Arsenal's UCL final appearance has secured £122M in UEFA prize money, putting the club in a strong financial position for the summer transfer window. The Gunners are planning sales alongside signings to balance spending.

items.headline: Arsenal targeting Bradley Barcola from PSG — 'encouraged' in pursuit
items.summary: Arsenal have reportedly received encouragement in their pursuit of PSG winger Bradley Barcola. The Gunners are looking to strengthen their left-wing options, with Barcola seen as a 'Saka 2.0' type profile. Ironic given they're about to face PSG in the UCL final.

items.headline: Arsenal also eyeing Nico Williams — reports of £60M bid potential
items.summary: Reports claim Arsenal could have a £60M bid accepted for Athletic Club's Nico Williams, described as 'one of the best left wingers in the world.' Williams has also attracted interest following a return to fitness.

items.headline: Bukayo Saka back from injury — Arteta's key card for title run-in
items.summary: Bukayo Saka has returned from injury for Arsenal, with pundits arguing he could be the difference-maker as the Gunners chase both the Premier League title (vs West Ham Sunday) and UCL glory (vs PSG May 30).

items.headline: Bucks officially introduce Taylor Jenkins — franchise rebuild begins
items.summary: Taylor Jenkins was formally introduced as Milwaukee's new head coach on Wednesday, with the organization paying over $10M annually as they attempt to retain Giannis and rebuild competitive credibility. Jenkins was previously head coach in Memphis.

items.headline: Owner Haslam puts clock on Giannis decision — 6-7 weeks to resolve
items.summary: Jimmy Haslam stated publicly at Jenkins' intro press conference that the next 6-7 weeks will shape the franchise's direction regarding Giannis Antetokounmpo. 'We will do what is best for Giannis and what is best for the organization.'

items.headline: Bucks eliminated by Pistons — AJ Green sets all-time franchise 3PT record
items.summary: Detroit's 137-111 win over Milwaukee ended the Bucks' season. In the loss, AJ Green hit 5 three-pointers to surpass Bucks Hall-of-Famer Ray Allen's all-time franchise record with 232 career threes.

items.headline: Tucker Kraft expected back early in 2026 season
items.summary: NFL roundup confirms Packers TE Tucker Kraft is on track to return early in the 2026 regular season from his injury. Good news for Green Bay's passing game heading into the fall.

items.headline: Packers OC confirms Jordan Morgan 'ready' for left tackle role
items.summary: Green Bay's offensive coordinator publicly stated Jordan Morgan is ready to handle left tackle responsibilities heading into 2026, providing some clarity on an important O-line question during rookie camp.

items.headline: 2026 NFL schedule release coming May 12-14
items.summary: The 2026 NFL schedule will officially drop between May 12-14 per Adam Schefter. Packers fans will learn their full schedule including prime time games, divisional matchups, and key road trips.

items.headline: MarShawn Lloyd health update — strongest he's ever been at rookie camp
items.summary: RB MarShawn Lloyd told reporters at rookie camp that he's in the best shape of his life and feeling healthy. If he can stay that way, he could provide meaningful depth behind the Packers' backfield.

youtube.title: Full Guide: Build An AI Second Brain With Codex
youtube.creator: Matt Wolfe
youtube.summary: Matt Wolfe walks through building a full AI second brain powered by Codex (OpenAI's latest coding model). Covers how to set up autonomous AI agents that can organize notes, surface relevant context, and act as a persistent knowledge system. Practical build guide format.

youtube.title: AI News: 18 Breaking Stories You Missed This Week
youtube.creator: Matt Wolfe
youtube.summary: Matt Wolfe's weekly AI news roundup covering 18 stories from the past week — model releases, tool launches, and industry moves. Good for catching anything missed across AI platforms. Broad overview format.
